mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.name, s.gender, s.age_text AS ageText, s.grade, s.school, s.status, cp.name AS campusName, ps.relation, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.remain_lessons) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND e.status = '生效'), 0) AS remainLessons, s.course_count AS courseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_comment cc WHERE cc.student_id = s.id AND cc.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadComments FROM wx_parent_student ps JOIN student s ON s.id = ps.student_id LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = s.campus_id WHERE ps.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY ps.id

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.name, s.gender, s.age_text AS ageText, s.grade, s.school, s.status, cp.name AS campusName, ps.relation, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.remain_lessons) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.student_id = s.id AND e.status = '生效'), 0) AS remainLessons, s.course_count AS courseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_comment cc WHERE cc.student_id = s.id AND cc.read_at IS NULL) AS unreadComments FROM wx_parent_student ps JOIN student s ON s.id = ps.student_id LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = s.campus_id WHERE ps.parent_id = #{parentId} AND ps.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT e.id AS enrollmentId, e.course_id AS courseId, co.name AS courseName, e.class_id AS classId, cg.name AS className, e.total_lessons AS totalLessons, e.gift_lessons AS giftLessons, e.used_lessons AS usedLessons, e.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, e.unit_price AS unitPrice, e.expire_date AS expireDate, e.status FROM enrollment e LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = e.class_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.status = '生效' ORDER BY e.remain_lessons DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.type, t.lessons, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, co.name AS courseName, t.note, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM lesson_txn t LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.id = t.enrollment_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = e.course_id WHERE t.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cc.id, cc.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, s.course_id AS courseId, co.name AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) AS teacherName, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, cc.content, cc.rating, cc.read_at AS readAt, cc.created_at AS createdAt FROM class_comment cc LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = cc.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id WHERE cc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY COALESCE(s.lesson_date, DATE(cc.created_at)) DESC, cc.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_comment WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_comment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE class_comment SET read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT gs.exam_id AS examId, ge.name AS examName, ge.type AS examType, ge.exam_date AS examDate, ge.full_score AS fullScore, ge.scoring_mode AS scoringMode, gs.class_id AS classId, cg.name AS className, ge.course_name AS courseName, gs.total_score AS totalScore, gs.level, gs.rank_class AS rankClass, gs.rank_campus AS rankCampus, gs.status, gs.remark, gs.part_scores AS partScoresJson FROM grade_score gs JOIN grade_exam ge ON ge.id = gs.exam_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = gs.class_id WHERE gs.student_id = #{studentId} AND ge.status = '已发布' ORDER BY ge.exam_date DESC, gs.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.message_id AS messageId, m.title, m.content, m.msg_type AS msgType, r.student_id AS studentId, r.student_name AS studentName, r.read_flag AS readFlag, r.read_at AS readAt, m.sent_at AS sentAt FROM wx_message_receiver r JOIN wx_message m ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_message_receiver r WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND r.read_flag = 0 AND r.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.id, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.room, s.status FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.lesson_date >= CURDATE() AND s.status = '待上课' AND (s.student_id = #{studentId} OR s.class_id IN (SELECT cs.class_id FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = '在读')) ORDER BY s.lesson_date, s.start_time LIMIT 5
